assembly_theorem.conclusion: complete one-/two-port coherence supplies segment, order, and one-global-T assembly for arbitrary attachment words over every primitive rigid support

one_global_triangle_gate.conclusion: at most the single ordinary triangle already present in the rigid-support anchor is transported globally
